support_gate_result.reason: The preregistered formal-evaluation support requirement was not met after all frozen feature validity, BTC-uptrend eligibility, training burn-in, shadow-prequential calibration burn-in and 56-day label-maturity constraints were applied.

first_formal_refit_calibration_example.interpretation: At the first formal refit the frozen prior-preserving calibration suppresses all fitted relative logits and emits the expanding prevalence prior. Aggregate candidate/B1/B2/B3 NLL and Brier are exactly equal over the observed formal window. This is descriptive only because G1 failed.

interpretation_boundary: 0048 is INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS and not FAIL, because the preregistered minimum dependence-aware support was not available in the frozen historical window.
G2 and all later inferential gates were not eligible to run; no bootstrap superiority, temporal robustness or HIGH-confidence eligibility claim may be made.
The adverse descriptive point metrics must be preserved as immutable evidence but cannot be converted into a formal failure after the G1 stopping rule fired.
0048 does not authorize 0049 concentration research, portfolio weights, CAGR/MDD testing, Beta-to-BTC handoff logic, BTC-to-cash logic or integrated routing.

Any attempt to reduce the 12-block support requirement, shorten burn-in, alter BTC eligibility, modify calibration, expand the historical window with already-visible data, retune features or rerun the same mechanism requires a new research ID and new preregistration.
design_lessons_non_authorizing: The preregistered support assumption was materially too optimistic once the complete causal pipeline and BTC-uptrend eligibility filter were applied: only four complete 56-observation formal blocks remained.

The frozen formal evaluation did contain both ETH-leading and SOL-leading outcomes across all four complete blocks, so the binding support failure was total block count rather than one-sided class absence.
The observed calibrated candidate and dynamic baselines did not show promising point-score evidence in this short formal segment; this is diagnostic only and cannot be used to rescue or retune 0048.
